title: What the site's onboarding offers a signed-in person
description: GET /api/v1/onboarding/site for any signed-in person: the repository mode, the integration steps in route order and the AI offer. It never carries the site's default repositories, their names or their number. A person whose account was created in auto or skip mode also gets the names the site fetches for them: only defaults the gateway's check found they can read at that sign-in, never the rest.

imports.description: This person's own plan from the sign-in in which their account was created: the defaults the site fetches for them (auto, skip). Absent otherwise.

site_key_copy.description: The site key copy the site gave this person, from the site's own record (at the sign-in that created the account or later by an administrator): its provider and last four characters, when, and whether it is still the key the site stores. It says what was given, not what their Pi holds now; the browser marks their key row as the site's only while its suffix matches.

ai_key_seeded.description: Present only when the sign-in that created this person's account seeded the site AI key into their own Pi credentials (its receipt). Their Pi status is then usable without the route having been walked, so the browser walks the route until the person's own first-route mark exists (first-route.schema.json). Never derived from the site's current offer.
